summary: Prototype rules passed emulator validation. Private training plans validate all twelve entries on create/update, require authenticated path ownership and sequential revisions. Session prescriptions are bounded and immutable after creation. No production deployment or audit guarantee is implied.

checks.update_bypass: same validTrainingPlan validator on create and update; malformed final slot rejected in emulator
checks.authority: request.auth.uid compared with uid in path; no client-supplied roles or owner fields
checks.business_logic: new plans change future sessions only; old session snapshot cannot be rewritten
checks.storage_limits: four day identifiers; exactly twelve bounded prescription strings; bounded focus and revision
checks.type_safety: string/list/integer types checked; server timestamp required
checks.cross_account_access: other account and guest denied in emulator
checks.existing_records: optional prescription preserves compatibility with existing session documents
